models.name: Qwen3.5 9B

engines.quant: jackrong Qwen3.5-9B DSV4 Flash distill, ~36 tok/s, full-day coding session against a ~30-file codebase

models.why: A 9B DSV4 Flash distill wrapped in Hermes/Pi/OverCR ran a full day of coding at ~36 tok/s through llama.cpp on an 8GB AMD RX 5700 XT — the low-VRAM setup people are told does not work; it hit the 64K context wall on the hardest task instead of running out of speed.
